description: Hermes/Android native A2A worker no-live conformance fixture for Gongyung/Daegyo-style Termux nodes. Covers registration, heartbeat/reconnect, bounded task execution, local redacted evidence manifest, and broker-visible result evidence without contacting any live provider, production broker, or private network.

conformanceSteps.description: Hermes native worker registers with loopback broker URL and no-secret metadata
conformanceSteps.androidCaveat: Registration uses Tailscale IP or local loopback; never use production broker URL without separate approval

conformanceSteps.description: Worker heartbeats with Termux-hermes flavor metadata and empty secrets
conformanceSteps.androidCaveat: Heartbeat interval must account for Android Doze windows; 20s sleep loop with bounded poll is recommended

conformanceSteps.description: Worker polls pending tasks via broker-agnostic alias
conformanceSteps.expectedOutcome: 200 OK with zero or more pending task records
conformanceSteps.androidCaveat: Poll while waking; accept empty responses as normal on idle mobile nodes

conformanceSteps.description: Worker claims and starts an assigned no-live task
conformanceSteps.expectedOutcome: 200 OK on claim, 200 OK on start

conformanceSteps.description: Worker executes a bounded handler task without Docker, build, GitHub push, or live provider access
conformanceSteps.expectedOutcome: Deterministic output; no side effects beyond local artifact root
conformanceSteps.androidCaveat: Use limited memory budget; avoid subprocesses that exceed Termux resource limits

conformanceSteps.description: Worker persists redacted local evidence manifest before network submission
conformanceSteps.androidCaveat: Artifact root on shared storage may be visible to other apps; ensure Termux private directory or 0700 permissions

conformanceSteps.description: Worker posts redacted terminal Done/Blocked evidence via broker-agnostic alias
conformanceSteps.expectedOutcome: 200 OK, task reaches terminal succeeded/failed state

conformanceSteps.description: Worker survives network drop or Termux restart by re-registering and re-polling on next loop iteration
conformanceSteps.expectedOutcome: Worker re-establishes registration and continues polling
conformanceSteps.androidCaveat: Termux:Boot script must acquire wake lock before network access; assume TCP drops at any time

conformanceSteps.description: Worker or admission function rejects tasks with Docker runner indicators or out-of-scope intents
conformanceSteps.expectedOutcome: NO-GO signal returned, task not claimed

conformanceSteps.description: Local evidence manifest passes redaction check: no device identifiers, provider tokens, private paths, or raw session dumps
conformanceSteps.expectedOutcome: manifest ok or structured blocked with redaction failure details

androidTermuxCaveats.sleepDoze: Android Doze suspends network access; poll loop must be bounded and tolerate empty responses
androidTermuxCaveats.wakeLock: Termux:Boot script must call termux-wake-lock before accessing network
androidTermuxCaveats.networkReconnect: Assume TCP drops at any time; each loop iteration re-registers and re-polls
androidTermuxCaveats.storagePaths: Use ~/.hermes/a2a/artifacts/ with 0700 permissions; avoid shared Termux storage
androidTermuxCaveats.secretHandling: Store secrets in ~/.config/a2a/hermes-worker.env with chmod 600; never paste into chat or evidence
androidTermuxCaveats.resourceLimits: Termux has limited memory and CPU; avoid Docker, heavy builds, and large subprocesses
androidTermuxCaveats.bootPersistence: Use ~/.termux/boot/a2a-hermes-worker boot script; verify wake lock after reboot
androidTermuxCaveats.noGateway: Hermes native worker does not require OpenClaw Gateway on-device; uses HTTP polling directly
